concerns.text: FR-007 (FWE correction) and SC-002 (sensitivity table) lack valid implementation tasks. T045.3 generates 'mock data' instead of real ROI-wise results, and T046 explicitly skips recomputing connectivity matrices for the window sweep, making it impossible to satisfy the spec's requirement to test flexibility across {20s, 30s, 40s}.

SC-003 (ΔR² precision) is untestable with current tasks. T043 returns a formatted string, but T051/T051b return a `RegressionResult` dataclass not defined to store this string. No task exists to update the data model or ensure the precision is preserved before formatting.

FR-006 (10k permutations) and SC-001 (p-value) are partially unsupported. T030 requires saving `permutation_results.csv` with `shuffle_id` and `correlation` per shuffle, but T027 only returns the final `empirical_p_value` and `distribution_of_max_stats`, discarding the individual shuffle correlations needed for the CSV.

FR-012 (per-participant static strength) coverage is incomplete. While T014.1 computes the metric, T014.2 and T014.4 aggregate it without a specific task to validate that the aggregation logic matches the 'per participant' requirement before passing to regression, risking silent aggregation errors.

SC-001 (per-subject p-value) is unsupported. T017 attempts to write a per-subject CSV row with an `empirical_p_value`, but T027 only produces a single global p-value for the whole dataset. No task exists to compute per-subject significance or adjust the schema.

FR-010 (sensitivity sweep) is logically broken. T046 states 'Do NOT re-run... sliding window connectivity computation' and loads pre-computed matrices. Since flexibility is derived from sliding windows, skipping the recomputation for different window lengths (20s, 30s, 40s) makes the sweep invalid.
